$comment: This app is HASH-routed, deliberately: CRM.tsx explains that crossing
between /#/apply/... and any other /#/... path is a same-document hash
change, which is what lets a public submission and the CRM's own read
of it share one live dataProvider instance.
So the real application link is /#/apply/living-example. The obvious
one — /apply/living-example, which is what anybody would type or paste
— was a hard 404, because nothing on disk matches that path and there
was no config here at all.
The redirect makes the obvious URL work. The catch-all rewrite stops
every other unmatched path returning a bare 404 page; Vercel checks the
filesystem first, so real assets still serve themselves.
